en.heroSub: Thermal Pros shows up fast, diagnoses right, and quotes fair. Licensed, EPA-certified, and ready 24/7.
en.about: Thermal Pros HVAC has been serving Scottsdale since 2016. We're a small team of EPA 608 and NATE-certified technicians who believe AC repair should be honest and fast. We service all major brands and specialize in heat-pump upgrades for Arizona homes. Call us for same-day diagnosis on most repair requests.

services.blurb: AC not cooling? We diagnose and fix it same day — compressor, capacitor, refrigerant, or thermostat.
services.description: Fast diagnosis, honest repair. We tell you what's wrong and show you options.

services.blurb: New system or upgrade to a heat pump? We handle sizing, install, and rebate paperwork.

services.name: Maintenance plans

reviews.quote: Called Thermal Pros at 3pm on a Saturday. Tech here by 4:30, AC running again by 6. Fair price, warranty on the repair. Will call again.

reviews.quote: Got a quote to replace the whole system for $6,500. Thermal Pros said it was just a refrigerant leak and a capacitor. $320 total. Been running great for 6 months.
